name: early-compact
description: Has Claude write a checkpoint once context passes a threshold, then compacts early with that checkpoint as the brief and resumes the work

thresholdPercent.title: Early-compact threshold (%)
thresholdPercent.description: Context-window fill at which the session is checkpointed and compacted

minTokens.title: Minimum tokens
minTokens.description: Never compact early below this many context tokens
